name: Cowork_QualityLessons
observations: REPORT COLUMN ORDER: Always place new columns in logical sequence relative to related fields. E.g. VAT and Total Commission belong immediately after Commission — not appended to the end. After adding via '+ Add Fields', drag them up to the correct position in the Configure Fields panel.

FORM FIELD PLACEMENT: After adding a new field to a form via the form builder, the field may not land in the expected visual position due to hidden fields shifting the drop target. Best practice: add the field, save, refresh the form builder page, check the actual position, and reposition if needed. Expect this to require multiple attempts.

ZOHO CREATOR LINK NAMES: Zoho Creator does NOT auto-update the field link name when you change the field display name. Always manually triple-click the link name input and type the correct value after setting the display name.

DELUGE SAVE BUTTON: In the workflow Deluge script editor, Save and Cancel buttons are close together. Use 'find' tool to get the exact ref for the Save button rather than clicking by coordinate — avoids accidentally triggering the Unsaved Changes dialog.
WORKFLOW NAME LIMIT: Zoho Creator workflow names have a 50-character limit. Keep names short and descriptive.
FORM BUILDER URL: Do not try to directly construct or guess the form builder URL. Always open it by clicking the Edit button from the Zoho Creator app dashboard.

CURRENCY FIELD TYPE: In Zoho Creator, monetary fields should use type = Currency (not Decimal) to get proper currency formatting. Confirm by clicking an existing similar field and reading the Field Properties panel.

DELUGE REAL-TIME CALC TRIGGER: For auto-calculating fields during form entry, use Form Event = 'User input of a field' with Record Event = 'Created'. This fires as the user tabs between fields, not just on save.

MEMORY MCP PERSISTENCE: The @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory v0.6.3 does NOT support --memory-path as a CLI argument. It only supports MEMORY_FILE_PATH as an environment variable. Without this env var, it runs in RAM only and all data is lost on app restart. Config fix: move from args to env.MEMORY_FILE_PATH.

CHROME MULTIPLE BROWSERS: If multiple Chrome browsers are connected, select_browser must be called with the correct deviceId before using any Chrome MCP tools. DeviceId for Hamza's browser: 4d516625-feed-4d98-b2fa-b1f19e15a9cc (Browser 1).

DELUGE EDITOR TAB KEY: NEVER use tab characters (\t) when typing code into Zoho Creator Deluge editor via automation. The editor intercepts Tab as autocomplete, inserting garbage like '<opr> <expression>)' into the code. Always use NO indentation or spaces only when typing Deluge via the type tool.

DELUGE EDITOR AUTOCOMPLETE DISMISS: After finishing typing in the Deluge editor, always press Escape BEFORE clicking Update — but do NOT press Escape when a legitimate 'Unsaved changes' dialog might appear. Better: click somewhere neutral in the editor body first to dismiss any autocomplete popup, then click Update by coordinate (1278, 769) not by find() ref.

DELUGE EDITOR UPDATE BUTTON: The find() tool returns wrong refs for the Update button in the Deluge script modal — it picks up background elements. Always click Update by coordinate: (1278, 769). Never use find() or ref to click it.

ZOHO CREATOR BUILDER URL: Direct URL navigation to creator.zoho.com/appbuilder/... fails with 'Something went wrong'. Always navigate to creator.zoho.com first, wait for dashboard, then click Edit on the app card.

ZOHO BOOKS CUSTOM FIELDS LOCATION: NOT under Settings > Customization. Correct path: Settings > Module Settings > Sales > Invoices > Field Customization tab. Use the settings search bar ('Custom Fields') to find it faster.
ZOHO CREATOR WORKFLOW SEARCH: Use the search box in the top-right of the Workflow list to find workflows by name. Much faster than scrolling.

name: Zoho Creator Widget SDK v2
observations: SDK loaded from: https://static.zohocdn.com/creator/widgets/version/2.0/widgetsdk-min.js
Available namespaces: ZOHO.CREATOR.DATA, META, FILE, PUBLISH, UTIL — NO WIDGET namespace
DATA.addRecords (plural) — NOT addRecord (singular)
addRecords params are snake_case: { app_name, form_name, payload: { data: { ...fields } } }
UTIL.navigateParentURL requires { action: <value> } — if action is missing it rejects with 'Improper Configuration'
Passing a full URL as action gives 'Improper action...!!!' from Zoho's parent handler — it does NOT accept raw URLs
window.top.location.href = url works as a reliable fallback for navigation when SDK rejects the URL
No setFieldValue or fill-form-field API exists — cannot pre-fill fields in an open form
SDK does NOT require init() — ZOHO object is available immediately after script load
Response code 3000 = success, 3002 = validation error (required fields missing)
iframe is cross-origin (github.io vs creatorapp.zoho.com) — window.frameElement is null, cannot resize iframe from within widget
No dynamic resize API in SDK v2 — iframe height must be set manually in Zoho Creator page builder
Solution for variable content height: height:100% + overflow-y:auto inside widget, set iframe height generously in builder

name: INSPT_AgentContra_Plan
observations: DATE: 2026-06-06. Agent contra balance system — design confirmed by Hamza.
LOGIC: Commission_Shared field is used for BOTH directions of agent money flow, interpreted by which role the agent plays on the policy.

SIDE 1 — INSPT owes agent: Policies where Sources_of_Business=Agent AND Agent_Source_Details=[agent name]. INSPT owes that agent = sum of Commission_Shared on those policies (agent brought the client, INSPT pays them a referral fee).

SIDE 2 — Agent owes INSPT: Policies where Insurer_Agents=[agent name] AND Insurers != AL MADINA. That agent owes INSPT = sum of Commission_Shared on those policies (agent placed policy via their channel, they owe INSPT the commission share).
NET CONTRA per agent = (Agent owes INSPT) - (INSPT owes agent). Positive = agent owes INSPT net. Negative = INSPT owes agent net.

PHASE 5 ERROR CONFIRMED (2026-06-06): Phase 5 built the agent commission expense in Zoho Books recording Commission_Shared as money INSPT pays OUT to the placement agent. This is WRONG for the Placement Agency scenario — in that case the agent owes INSPT, not the other way around. Phase 5 needs to be rebuilt: the Placement Agency Commission_Shared should be recorded as a RECEIVABLE (money coming in from agent), not an Expense (money going out). The Source of Business Agent Commission_Shared should be the Expense.

BUILD PLAN: (1) Fix Phase 5 — reverse the Zoho Books entry for Placement Agency policies: record as receivable/invoice to agent, not expense. (2) Add a new workflow for Source=Agent policies: record as expense (Commission_Shared paid to agent who sourced the business). (3) Build contra report in Creator — per agent card showing: policies as Placement Agency (agent owes INSPT), policies as Source Agent (INSPT owes agent), net balance. observations: ZOHO SDK v2 INIT ANTI-PATTERN (2026-06-07): NEVER use ZOHO.CREATOR.init().then(load) in a Creator widget. SDK v2 does NOT support init(). The ZOHO object is available immediately after script load. Correct pattern: just call load() directly at bottom of script. CREATOR EMPTY LOOKUP FIELD FORMAT (2026-06-07): When a Creator lookup field has no value selected, the SDK does NOT return null or {}. name: Cowork_QualityLessons
observations: SDK_NOT_LOADED FIX (2026-06-08): Claude Code generated dashboards check for ZOHO.CREATOR.load() which does NOT exist in SDK v2, causing immediate SDK_NOT_LOADED error. NEVER check typeof ZOHO.CREATOR.load. CORRECT boot pattern: use a waitForSDK polling loop — poll every 100ms up to 30 times (3 seconds total), check window.ZOHO && window.ZOHO.CREATOR && window.ZOHO.CREATOR.DATA, then call boot() directly. If 30 tries exhausted, call showError('SDK_NOT_LOADED'). Code: function waitForSDK(tries){ tries=tries||0; if(window.ZOHO&&window.ZOHO.CREATOR&&window.ZOHO.CREATOR.DATA){ skeleton(); boot(); } else if(tries>30){ showError('SDK_NOT_LOADED'); } else { setTimeout(function(){ waitForSDK(tries+1); },100); } } waitForSDK();
